name: bq-income-tax
description: Analyse personal income tax for 2026 in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for BES residence, global income, employment expenses, business profits, savings interest, substantial interests, loss carryforwards, annual tariff, tax-free sum, contribution credits and assessment procedure. Distinguishes taxable income from the taxable sum, the statutory upper-band constant and matching insurance credits from separate premiums. Includes employee, sole-trader and mixed-income arithmetic under stated assumptions, primary sources and refusal conditions. This source-cited draft holds unresolved mortgage relief, insurance eligibility, final rounding, foreign relief and return mapping. It does not authorise filing or payment.
